english.title: Manufacture prohibited smooth-bore revolver
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the Secretary of State, manufactured a smooth-bore revolver gun other than one which was chambered for 9mm rim-fire cartridges or a muzzle-loading gun, namely **(..SPECIFY WEAPON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(ad) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording is obsolete - see H6111.
(ii) See also associated offence wordings: H1793, H1795 and H2223.
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Either way
